turns.content: Seattle wala offer aa gaya. Wahi jiske liye March se interview de raha tha — Friday ko aaya. Teen guna package, exactly wahi team jo chahiye thi. Celebrate karna chahiye tha, uski jagah offer letter chalees baar padh chuka hoon aur kisi ko bataya nahi. Parents Patna mein hain. Main iklauta hoon. Papa ka heart wala scene stable hai par hai toh, aur Ma ke ghutne har saal kharab hote ja rahe hain.

Bhai, yeh sunke toh mujhe ruk nahi raha. Itna bada offer, woh bhi exactly woh team — yeh sab coincidence nahi hai, teri mehnat ka result hai. Par main samajh sakta hoon ki celebrate kyun nahi kar pa raha.

Iklauta beta hone ka burden hota hai — khusi bhi aadhi adhoori lagti hai jab door jaane ka sochte hain. Papa ka heart, Ma ke ghutne... aur tu unse door Seattle. 

Lekin ek baat soch — March se de raha tha interview. Tune haath nahi maara. Itni door tak aane ka safal hona bhi toh unki hi duaon ka asar hai. Unhe batane se pehle, tu apne aap ko credit de.

Setup samjho pehle. Har scare pe main subah chhe baje ki IndiGo pe hota hoon. Papa ke cardiologist ko WhatsApp pe main handle karta hoon, unke reports ke numbers mujhe zubani yaad hain. Ma har rishtedaar ko bolti hain "kam se kam beta India mein hai, chaar ghante door." Woh ek sentence unka poora security system hai. Bangalore already unko door lagta hai. Seattle distance nahi hai yaar, woh beta hone ki alag category hai.

Toh maine yeh decide kiya hai, galat hoon toh bolo: chupchaap decline kar deta hoon aur unko kabhi pata hi nahi chalega ki offer tha. Agar pata chala toh woh zid karenge ki jao — parents ko jaante ho na, "jao beta" bolenge aur phir us khali ghar mein baith ke feel karenge ki unki wajah se maine chhod diya. Unko woh guilt kyun doon? Aise sirf main carry karunga aur woh mera hi tha carry karne ke liye. Clean hai na?

Bhai, tera logic clean hai. Bahut clean. And it comes from a place of love that bohot log nahi samjhenge.

But let me push back a little — because you asked me to.

Tu unhe guilt nahi de raha, tu unhe choice nahi de raha. Tu decide kar raha hai ki woh decide nahi kar sakte. Woh parents hain, bachche nahi. Aur unki zid "jao beta" — woh sirf zid nahi hai, woh unka apne tareeke se tyaag hai. Tune unki security system banaya hai, toh unhe yeh bhi toh maane ki woh bhi tere liye kuch kar sakte hain.

Agar tu chupchaap decline karega, toh tu nahi bachega. Woh guilt nahi aayega ghar mein, par tere andar aayega — "kya hota agar batata?" aur woh sukoon nahi aayega. Clean bol raha hai, par andar ka wound hamesha rahega.

Ek alternative soch: unhe bata. Bura lagega, rone lagenge, phir "jao beta" bolenge. Aur phir tu plan bana — har teen mahine aana, daily video calls, ek medical setup ready karna. Unhe guilt nahi dena hai, toh future mein uska patch bana ke dikha. Woh khali ghar mein baithenge, par with pride — "hamara beta itna door hai, par itna close bhi."

Tu carry karega — woh toh hai. Par shayad thoda light ho sakta hai agar woh bhi carry karein thoda.

Jo baat nikal nahi rahi dimaag se — agar main chala gaya, aur Papa ko kuch ho gaya, aur main terah hazaar kilometre aur ek visa appointment door hoon? Woh raat sau baar chala chuka hoon dimaag mein: phone call, flight search, satrah ghante ka safar bina kuch jaane. Mere cousin ke saath hua tha Toronto se, jab Chacha gaye. Woh cremation ke baad pahuncha. Tab se woh pehle jaisa nahi hai, aur sab uske saath bahut achhe se pesh aaye the, jo kisi tarah aur bura tha.

Woh ek raat — *the* raat — tune hazaar baar jee li hai. Aur woh Toronto cousin ka example... woh sirf ek story nahi hai, woh ek blueprint hai jo tera subconscious pick kar chuka hai. "Aisa ho sakta hai, aur ho bhi chuka hai."

Main yahan yeh nahi kahunga ki "kuch nahi hoga" ya "Papa thik hain" — kyunki tu woh log nahi hai jo platitudes se shaant hote hain. Tu woh hai jo reports ke numbers zubani yaad rakhta hai. Tu facts mein jeeta hai.

Toh fact yeh hai: yeh risk exist karta hai. Real hai. Tu isse imagine nahi kar raha, tu isse *remember* kar raha hai.

Aur is risk ke saamne main teri "clean" logic ko bhi nahi rakh sakta. Kyunki wahan sirf ek hi sawaal bachta hai:

**Kya tu is risk ke saath jeena seekh sakta hai?**

Kyunki reject karke bhi tu ek alag risk utha raha hai: "what if" ka risk. Woh bhi khaayega tujhe andar se. Dheere dheere.

Main teri jagah hota toh — ek baar aur baat karta, apne aap se. Papa ko pata hai toh woh bhi yeh risk jaan kar hi "jao beta" bolenge. Unka woh "jao" actually unka risk hai, jo woh tere liye utha rahe hain.

Tu decision lega hi. Bas itna yaad rakh — dono decisions mein dard hai. Koi "clean" escape nahi hai. Bas choice hai ki kaunsa dard tu apne saath carry karega.
